name: moonshot_list_models
description: List all available Moonshot AI (Kimi) models including moonshot-v1-8k, moonshot-v1-32k, moonshot-v1-128k, and vision models.

name: moonshot_chat
description: Chat completion with a Kimi/Moonshot model. Supports moonshot-v1-8k (default), 32k, and 128k context windows. Strong Chinese and English bilingual performance.

system.description: Optional system prompt prepended to messages

name: moonshot_chat_json
description: Chat completion with JSON mode enforced. The model will always return valid JSON. Returns both the parsed object and raw string.

name: moonshot_chat_long
description: Chat completion using moonshot-v1-128k for processing very large documents or contexts up to 128,000 tokens. Ideal for long-form analysis.

name: moonshot_vision_chat
description: Chat with an image input using Moonshot's vision model. Accepts image URL or base64 encoded image data alongside a text prompt.

prompt.description: Text prompt or question about the image

image_url.description: URL of the image to analyze

image_base64.description: Base64 encoded image data (alternative to image_url)

image_media_type.description: MIME type of base64 image (default: image/jpeg)

name: moonshot_function_call
description: Chat completion with function/tool definitions. The model can decide to call one or more of the provided tools. Returns tool_calls array.

tools.description: Array of tool definitions with name, description, and parameters

name: moonshot_embed_text
description: Generate text embeddings using Moonshot's embedding model. Accepts a single string or array of strings. Returns embedding vectors.

text.description: Text string or array of strings to embed

name: moonshot_upload_file
description: Upload a file to Moonshot for text extraction. Supports PDF, DOCX, TXT, and other document formats. Returns file_id for content extraction.

file_content.description: File content as text or base64 encoded data

name: moonshot_list_files
description: List all files uploaded to Moonshot. Returns file IDs, names, sizes, and creation timestamps.

name: moonshot_get_file
description: Get metadata for a specific uploaded file by its file_id. Returns filename, size, status, and creation time.

name: moonshot_delete_file
description: Delete an uploaded file from Moonshot by its file_id. Frees storage quota.

name: moonshot_get_file_content
description: Extract and return the text content from an uploaded file. Moonshot parses PDFs, Word docs, and other formats into plain text.

file_id.description: File ID of the uploaded document

name: moonshot_get_balance
description: Check the current API credit balance for the Moonshot account. Returns available balance and total topped up.

name: moonshot_list_usage
description: Get API usage history for the Moonshot account. Filter by year and month to see token consumption and costs.

name: moonshot_parse_document
description: SUPER TOOL: Upload a document file and immediately extract all its text content in one call. Handles PDF, DOCX, TXT and more. Returns file_id and extracted text.

file_content.description: File content as text or base64

name: moonshot_long_context_summarize
description: SUPER TOOL: Summarize a very large document (up to 128K tokens) using moonshot-v1-128k. Returns structured or plain summary with usage stats. Ideal for contracts, reports, and research papers.

text.description: Full document text to summarize (up to ~512K characters)

format.description: Output format: structured (default, with sections) or plain

name: moonshot_compare_documents
description: SUPER TOOL: Compare two documents using moonshot-v1-128k and return a structured analysis of differences and similarities. Useful for contract comparison, changelog analysis, and document review.

comparison_focus.description: What aspect to focus comparison on (default: key differences and similarities)
